DDD Commenting Guidelines

Goal

Explain:

  • Why the class exists
  • Business rules (invariants)
  • Boundaries

Avoid:

  • Explaining obvious code
  • Redundant comments

Aggregate Root

Must include:

  • Purpose
  • Invariants
  • Design decisions

Value Object

Must include:

  • Immutability
  • Validation rules

Use Cases

Must include:

  • Responsibilities
  • What it does NOT do

Example

///

/// Represents a tenant. /// /// Invariants: /// - Must always have at least one owner ///
